title: Criminal justice and criminality in Amsterdam, 1680-1810
contributors: S. Faber (Vrije Universiteit, Amsterdam (research initiator, data collector))
descriptions: The dataset contains different categories of offences, crimes and sentences of criminals in Amsterdam during the 1680-1810 period.
